rows.form_factor: Handheld iPhone Pro/Pro Max from 12 Pro; iPad Pro from 2020
rows.weight_power: iPad Pro 11-inch (2020) cited at 471 g. iPhone mass and LiDAR power unknown.
rows.range: Apple 2020: up to 5 m. Polycam processing cap 5 m.
rows.precision_vs_tls: Not TLS. Apple publishes no mm accuracy. iPhone 12 Pro / 15 Pro RMSE vs primitives 2.05 cm and 2.06 cm (Remote Sensing Letters 2026). iPad Pro SiteScape vs TLS ICP RMS ~2 cm ± 3 cm (ISPRS 2021).
rows.stud_plumb_suitability: Poor as sole sensor for ~0.12 deg / few-mm tip offset. Centimeter error exceeds derived 8 ft offset.
rows.cost_availability: Consumer Pro devices. ARKit depth; app smoothing unknown vs raw.

rows.form_factor: iOS app. Space Mode LiDAR vs non-LiDAR photogrammetry.
rows.weight_power: Phone. Cloud preset uses Polycam servers. Power unknown.
rows.precision_vs_tls: Help Center says up to 98% under optimal conditions. Not an RMSE. Do not convert to mm.
rows.stud_plumb_suitability: Same limit as S1. Named Photo/Detail hybrid mode not found.
rows.cost_availability: Point-cloud export (LAS, PLY, PTS, XYZ, DXF) is Business and Enterprise. Free is GLTF only.

rows.form_factor: Tripod TLS. Examples FARO Focus Premium, Leica RTC360, Leica BLK360 SE.
rows.weight_power: RTC360 5.2 kg without batteries; battery 340 g; typically up to 4 h. FARO and BLK360 SE mass unknown here.
rows.range: FARO Focus Premium white 90% 0.5-200 m (Max 0.5-400 m). RTC360 0.5-130 m. BLK360 SE 0.5-45 m.
rows.precision_vs_tls: Vendor claims. FARO 3D accuracy 2 mm @ 10 m, angular 19 arcsec. RTC360 1.9 mm @ 10 m, angular 18 arcsec. BLK360 SE 4 mm @ 10 m.
rows.stud_plumb_suitability: Only class with published specs at millimeter / sub-0.1 deg order. End-to-end stud angle on site unknown.
rows.cost_availability: Professional capital equipment. Street price unknown.

rows.form_factor: Overlapping photos; Polycam non-LiDAR mode; Pix4D-class processing.
rows.range: No single range. Set by baseline and GSD.
rows.precision_vs_tls: Pix4D: GCPs raise absolute accuracy; no universal mm RMSE published.
rows.stud_plumb_suitability: Unknown. Not assumed better than phone LiDAR without control.
rows.cost_availability: Phone photos cheap. Pix4D commercial. Polycam point export needs Business/Enterprise.

rows.form_factor: Optical see-through glasses plus compute puck. Two tracking cameras, one high-res camera, 6DoF.
rows.weight_power: Official page omits grams. Puck battery 4455 mAh, 34.84 Wh. Secondary review under 95 g / 270 g puck is unverified.
rows.range: Survey range unknown. Display FOV 70 deg.
rows.precision_vs_tls: No depth RMSE on the official page.
rows.stud_plumb_suitability: Display, not capture scanner. Unsuitable as the metrology sensor.
rows.cost_availability: Base model not more than US$1500 before tax. Fall 2026 launch.

rows.modality: Stereo depth camera (ZED 2i as used by WFC-Dataset)
rows.weight_power: Unknown. Stereolabs spec sheet not opened.
rows.precision_vs_tls: Unknown. Dataset does not state accuracy.
rows.stud_plumb_suitability: Controlled single-stud capture. Not evidence of 0.12 deg wall plumb.

rows.form_factor: Small RF chipset, monostatic radar or two-device ranging.
rows.range: Construction max range unknown. Omnidirectional presence sensing described.
rows.precision_vs_tls: Vendor: fine ranging < 10 cm. White paper: ~30 cm spatial resolution at 500 MHz.
rows.stud_plumb_suitability: Not suitable. Resolution cell much larger than a stud face.

rows.form_factor: 60 GHz FMCW module with onboard DSP.
rows.weight_power: TIDEP-01000 short-range config: 2 W. Mass unknown.
rows.range: Short-range people-counting config: 8.1 m; FOV 120 deg horizontal, 40 deg vertical.
rows.precision_vs_tls: Reference design: people localized to ±10 cm. Range resolution 8.4 cm. Static-clutter removal in area-scanner demo.
rows.stud_plumb_suitability: Not suitable for mm-class stud edges.
